description: This file is a CLI (command-line interface) script for a project initialization tool called 'universalinit'. It handles parsing command-line arguments, creating project configurations, generating template information, and outputting results in JSON format. It also supports retrieving the run command for specific project types.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: A class representing various configuration details for project templates, including commands and environment settings.

classes.name: ProjectConfig
classes.description: A class encapsulating configuration parameters for a project, such as name, version, description, author, type, path, and parameters.

classes.name: ProjectType
classes.description: An enumeration or class that defines different project types and provides a method to create an instance from a string.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: A class responsible for initializing projects and creating template instances based on configurations.

classes.name: TemplateFactory
classes.description: A factory class used within ProjectInitializer to create project templates.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] parse_parameters(params_str: str)
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of key=value pairs into a dictionary with interpreted value types.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_project_config(args)
methods.description: Creates a ProjectConfig object from CLI arguments.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_minimal_project_config(project_type: str, parameters: str = None)
methods.description: Creates a minimal ProjectConfig object primarily to retrieve template info.

methods.name: str make_path_absolute(path: str, base_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a relative path to an absolute path based on a given base path.

methods.name: dict template_init_info_to_dict(init_info: TemplateInitInfo, project_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a TemplateInitInfo object into a dictionary, converting relevant paths to absolute paths.

methods.name: output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
methods.description: Formats and prints a JSON output indicating success/failure, message, and template configuration.

methods.name: output_get_run_command(project_type: str, run_command: str)
methods.description: Outputs the run command for a specified project type in JSON format.

methods.name: handle_get_run_command(args)
methods.description: Handles the logic for the --get-run-command option, retrieving the appropriate run command info.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main function that parses CLI arguments, manages the control flow for project initialization or retrieval of run commands.

ctags.name: output_json

ctags.signature: (success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
